# Provider layout

<!-- Code generated by go run ./layout/gen; DO NOT EDIT. Source: layout/table.go -->

Where each agent CLI reads its files, skills and config, relative to which launch root, and the flag, environment and working directory that locate them. Every row cites the Step 0 probe ids that measured it (see [HARNESS-DISCOVERY.md](HARNESS-DISCOVERY.md)); rows with no probe say why. A shape is a transport mode (the agent-contracts-leaf runtimes vocabulary) plus an optional launch variant such as Claude's `bare`; `all` means every mode, and the most specific row of a concern wins. Copilot and Pi have no rows: they are launched only over ACP. Skills are placed in the directory form `<rel>/<name>/SKILL.md` only.

## claude

| shape | concern | root | rel | form | file mode | flag | env | cwd | probe | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| all | instructions | boot | `CLAUDE.md` |  |  |  |  | boot | none | Unprobed: instruction file auto-load is a model-visible effect Step 0 does not measure (no model call). |
| subprocess-per-turn+bare | instructions | boot | `CLAUDE.md` |  |  | `--append-system-prompt-file` |  | boot | none | Unprobed: --bare skips CLAUDE.md discovery; the flag delivers it (model-visible, not measured). |
| all | boot | boot | `boot.md` |  |  |  |  |  | none | Unprobed: kick-off content read by the launcher, not discovered by the harness. |
| all | mcp | boot | `.mcp.json` |  | 0600 | `--mcp-config` |  | boot | CFG1, CFG4 | read from cwd by convention (CFG1) and by --mcp-config &lt;file&gt; (CFG4) |
| all | native-config | boot | `.claude/settings.json` |  |  |  |  | boot | CFG1 | read from cwd .claude/settings.json in -p mode; --add-dir loads neither settings nor .mcp.json (CFG3) |
| subprocess-per-turn+bare | native-config | boot | `.claude/settings.json` |  |  | `--settings` |  | boot | CFG2 | --bare skips cwd discovery, so the file is passed explicitly |
| all | skills | boot | `.claude/skills` | dir |  |  |  | boot | C1, C2 | &lt;cwd&gt;/.claude/skills/&lt;name&gt;/SKILL.md; flat &lt;name&gt;.md is not read |
| subprocess-per-turn+bare | skills | boot | `.claude/skills` | dir |  | `--add-dir` |  | boot | C4, C5 | --bare reads no cwd or user skills (C4); only &lt;--add-dir dir&gt;/.claude/skills (C5), so the boot root must itself be --add-dir'ed when skills are projected |
| all | project-dir | project |  |  |  | `--add-dir` |  | boot | C3, C5 | extra directory, not a working root; accepted in every mode, and the built-in launch convention passes it in every mode |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| all | instructions | boot | `AGENTS.md` |  |  |  |  | boot | CFG2, CFG3 | AGENTS.md is read from cwd and from $CODEX_HOME |
| all | boot | boot | `boot.md` |  |  |  |  |  | none | Unprobed: kick-off content read by the launcher, not discovered by the harness. |
| all | native-config | boot | `config.toml` |  | 0600 |  | `CODEX_HOME=<boot>` | boot | CFG2, CFG3 | $CODEX_HOME/config.toml. A .codex/config.toml under a redirected HOME also works (CFG4) but is not this convention; a project .codex/config.toml was not applied (untrusted, CFG1) |
| all | auth | boot | `auth.json` |  | 0600 |  | `CODEX_HOME=<boot>` | boot | none | Unprobed: credential placeholder resolved by runtime preparation; no credential is used by Step 0. |
| all | mcp | boot | `.mcp.json` |  | 0600 |  |  |  | none | Unprobed: mirror for operators; Codex reads MCP servers from config.toml, not this file. |
| all | skills | boot | `skills` | dir |  |  | `CODEX_HOME=<boot>` | boot | X2, X3, X4 | $CODEX_HOME/skills/&lt;name&gt;/SKILL.md survives with and without --cd &lt;project&gt;; &lt;boot&gt;/.agents/skills does not survive --cd (X2 vs X3), and singular skill/ and flat .md are never read |
| subprocess-per-turn | project-dir | project |  |  |  | `--cd` |  |  | X3 | --cd is the working root (codex -C), not an extra directory; app-server takes the project root over JSON-RPC instead |
